# LAN Server Enhanced

> *"Playing together has never been this seamless. Distance is no longer a barrier."*

**LAN Server Enhanced** is a Minecraft 1.21.1 (Fabric) modpack designed to revolutionize how you play with your friends. No more complicated server setups or paying for hosting just to play a casual session. This pack focuses on maximizing performance, enhancing quality of life, and making world-sharing as simple as somes clicks.

---

## About

Tired of the lag and limitations of standard multiplayer? **LAN Server Enhanced** transforms your local worlds into fully optimized multiplayer hubs, with famous server . Whether you want to host a quick session for friends far away or enjoy a smooth LAN party in the same room, this pack has you covered.

We've carefully selected performance mods, network optimizations, and essential quality-of-life features to ensure that both the host and the players experience Minecraft at its absolute best — without sacrificing the vanilla feel.

## Recommendations

* **Minimum RAM:** 2–4GB allocated to Minecraft (for players joining)
* **Recommended RAM:** 4–6GB for the Host (depending on the number of players)
* Essential network features are pre-configured for instant play! 🎮
